name: Trustmark Corporation
summary: Trustmark Corporation operates as the bank holding company for Trustmark National Bank that provides banking and other financial solutions to individuals and corporate institutions in the United States. It operates through General Banking and Wealth Management segments. The company offers checking, savings and money market accounts, and certificates of deposit, as well as certificates of deposit and individual retirement accounts; and treasury management services.
